t0003-01.gloss: A county access key and a closure record contradict each other.
t0003-01.rival_reading: A farm worker could mark a temporary gate closure and reclaim a county key after a shift; a crossed-out route does not prove an official evacuation failure.

t0003-02.gloss: Seed stock and a freshly used tool were wrapped together.
t0003-02.rival_reading: A response crew could move seed stock and tools while clearing a farm; the clean grip could come from ordinary handling.
